title: Zesty Springy Norwegian Lamb Skillet
description: A hearty Norwegian dish featuring lamb, piccalilli, and spring vegetables, perfect for a brunch gathering. This gluten-free friendly recipe is sure to please.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the lamb, cooking until browned on all sides.
Remove the lamb from the skillet and set aside, then add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the piccalilli to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the skillet and add the chopped parsley, salt, and pepper, stirring to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes or until the lamb is tender.
Shock the skillet in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Serve the lamb and vegetables hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
